rules.statement: A donee retains the option to either retain his gift and renounce his share in the donor's estate, or bring the value of the property into collation if he wishes to participate in the inheritance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus, if a father gave property to his son on the occasion of the son's marriage, and died intestate, the son had the option of renouncing all claim to share in his father's estate or of bringing the property into collation. If he chose the latter alternative, he had a further option of bringing in either the property itself or the value thereof."
